Oral Order

The present writ petition has been filed seeking the following relief(s):-
"1.(i) For setting aside the order dated 30/11/18 (Annexure 3) Passed by the Adjudicating officer Cum Additional Collector Saharsa in Adjudication Case No 6/18 -19 whereby and whereunder the Petitioner has been directed to deposit the fine of rupees two lakhs.
(ii) For restraining the respondents from initiating Certificate Case Proceeding against the Petitioner.

(iii) For direction upon the respondents not to take Patna High Court CWJC No.1867 of 2023(2) dt.04-09-2023 any follow up action against the Petitioner in view of the Sita Ram Sah vs The State Of Bihar on 4 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/181944508/
1 aforesaid order as contained in Annexure- 3 of this Petition."
2. At the outset, the learned counsel for the petitioner seeks liberty on behalf of the petitioner to challenge the impugned order dated 30.11.2018, passed by the Adjudicating Officer-cum-Additional Collector, Saharsa in Adjudication Case No.6 of 2018-19, by filing appropriate appeal under Section 76 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Sita Ram Sah vs The State Of Bihar
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Liberty so sought is granted.
3. The present writ petition stands disposed off.

(Mohit Kumar Shah, J) sonal/-
